name: What insulation options are best for homes in Huntington Beach or Irvine?

mainEntity.name: What insulation options are best for homes in Huntington Beach or Irvine?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homes in coastal Southern California areas like Huntington Beach and Irvine, which experience moderate climates, a balanced approach to insulation is effective. Focus on ensuring adequate R-values in attics (typically R-38 to R-49) and sealing air leaks to manage both heating and cooling costs. Spray foam can provide excellent air sealing and thermal performance, while blown-in cellulose or fiberglass are also strong contenders for attics and walls, balancing cost and efficiency for the local climate.
